definitions.gloss: urban area; city area; metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: The urbanized part of a region, as opposed to rural areas. Used in news, statistics, and policy discussions to refer to cities and their surrounding developed zones.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Rent is high in urban areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{都市部|としぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}している→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The population is concentrated in urban areas.

examples.japanese: {都市部|としぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Lifestyles differ greatly between urban areas and rural regions.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (city) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part/area). Refers to the urbanized part of a region, as opposed to rural or suburban areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市部|としぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in an urban area
- {都市部|としぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧: urban population
- {大|おお}{都市部|としぶ}: major metropolitan area
- {都市部|としぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: urban and rural areas
- {都市部|としぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧: to be concentrated in urban areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: rural regions, the provinces
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs
- {農村部|のうそんぶ}: agricultural/rural areas

USAGE:
Common in news, statistics, and policy discussions. In Japan, the {都市部|としぶ} vs. ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ divide is a major social and political topic, involving issues like population decline in rural areas (⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧) and overcrowding in cities (⟦{過密|かみつ}→過密：14420_kamitsu⟧).
